# Astrological Personal Analysis Report Template ## Client Information - Full Name: [Client Name] - Birth Date: [MM/DD/YYYY] - Birth Time (exact, if available): [HH:MM AM/PM, Time Zone] - Birth Location: [City, State/Province, Country] - Report Generation Date: [Current Date] --- ## Section 1: The Core Three: Sun, Moon, Rising Sign Foundation This section explains the three most critical placements that form the backbone of every birth chart, representing 70% of core personality, emotional drivers, and public presentation: ### 1.1 Sun Sign: Your Core Identity - **What it represents**: The essence of who you are, your life purpose, core values, vitality, and the traits you exhibit when you are most authentically yourself. It is the "why" behind your decisions and long-term goals. - Placeholder: [Sun Sign Name] in [House Number] → [Detailed interpretation: e.g., "Sun in Aries in the 1st House means you are a natural leader, driven by action, and present as confident and forward-focused to others."] ### 1.2 Moon Sign: Your Inner Emotional World - **What it represents**: Your unconscious emotional needs, how you process feelings, what makes you feel safe, and your instinctive reactions to stress or comfort. It governs your closest relationships and private self. - Placeholder: [Moon Sign Name] in [House Number] → [Detailed interpretation: e.g., "Moon in Cancer in the 4th House means you prioritize family and home security, and you nurture others through acts of care and practical support."] ### 1.3 Rising (Ascendant) Sign: Your Public Mask - **What it represents**: The first impression you give to others, your default social presentation, how you navigate new environments, and the lens through which you approach life experiences. - Placeholder: [Rising Sign Name] → [Detailed interpretation: e.g., "Libra Rising means you come across as diplomatic, charming, and focused on fairness in all initial interactions, even if your inner self is more assertive."] --- ## Section 2: Full Birth Chart Analysis (Personality Overview) This section breaks down all planetary placements and their house positions to provide a holistic view of strengths, challenges, and inherent tendencies. ### 2.1 Planetary Placements by House For each planet, include core meaning, house placement context, and actionable takeaways: | Planet | Sign & House | Core Interpretation | Strengths | Growth Areas | |--------|--------------|---------------------|-----------|--------------| | Mercury (communication, thought process) | [Sign] in [House] | [e.g., "Mercury in Gemini in the 3rd House means you are a quick thinker, skilled at verbal communication, and curious about learning new skills."] | [List 2-3 strengths] | [List 1-2 areas to focus on] | | Venus (love, values, attraction, aesthetics) | [Sign] in [House] | [Interpretation] | [Strengths] | [Growth areas] | | Mars (action, drive, anger expression) | [Sign] in [House] | [Interpretation] | [Strengths] | [Growth areas] | | Jupiter (luck, expansion, belief systems) | [Sign] in [House] | [Interpretation] | [Strengths] | [Growth areas] | | Saturn (limits, responsibility, long-term lessons) | [Sign] in [House] | [Interpretation] | [Strengths] | [Growth areas] | | Uranus (innovation, change, rebellion) | [Sign] in [House] | [Interpretation] | [Strengths] | [Growth areas] | | Neptune (spirituality, illusion, creativity) | [Sign] in [House] | [Interpretation] | [Strengths] | [Growth areas] | | Pluto (transformation, power, deep change) | [Sign] in [House] | [Interpretation] | [Strengths] | [Growth areas] | ### 2.2 Element Balance Analysis (Concluding Birth Chart Section) Break down the percentage of each of the four elements in your chart, explaining what excess or lack of each means for your lived experience: | Element | Percentage in Chart | Interpretation | |---------|---------------------|----------------| | Fire (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius) | [X%] |
- **Excess (>30%)**: You are highly energetic, impulsive, and driven to take action, but may burn out quickly or overlook details.
- **Lack (<15%)**: You struggle to initiate new projects or assert yourself, and may rely on others to motivate you.
- **Balanced**: You have a healthy mix of ambition and patience when pursuing goals. | | Earth (Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn) | [X%] |
- **Excess (>30%)**: You are highly practical and grounded, but may be overly rigid, resistant to change, or focused on material security at the cost of joy.
- **Lack (<15%)**: You struggle to follow through on plans, manage finances, or execute long-term projects that require consistent effort.
- **Balanced**: You can turn ideas into tangible results effectively. | | Air (Gemini, Libra, Aquarius) | [X%] |
- **Excess (>30%)**: You are highly intellectual and social, but may overthink decisions, detach from your emotions, or prioritize logic over empathy.
- **Lack (<15%)**: You struggle to communicate your needs objectively, or to see multiple perspectives in conflict.
- **Balanced**: You can communicate clearly and relate to diverse viewpoints easily. | | Water (Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces) | [X%] |
- **Excess (>30%)**: You are highly empathetic and emotionally intuitive, but may be overly sensitive, take on others' emotions, or avoid conflict to keep the peace.
- **Lack (<15%)**: You struggle to identify or express your own emotions, and may seem detached to people close to you.
- **Balanced**: You have a healthy relationship with your emotions and can empathize with others without becoming overwhelmed. | --- ## Section 3: Synastry Analysis: Compatibility for Partners & Friends This section provides equal guidance for both romantic partnership compatibility and platonic friendship compatibility, highlighting what to look for in both types of connections: ### 3.1 Core Compatibility Factors (Applies to Both Partners & Friends) - **Sun/Moon/Rising Alignment**: [Interpretation of how your core three placements interact with potential connections: e.g., "Your Aries Sun pairs well with Leo and Sagittarius suns for both friends and partners, as you share a love of adventure and direct communication."] - **Mercury Alignment**: Communication style compatibility, whether you will understand each other's thought processes and conflict resolution styles. - **Venus Alignment: Shared values and what you both prioritize in relationships, from quality time to gift giving. ### 3.2 Romantic Partner Specific Traits to Look For - Mars alignment: Sexual compatibility, how you both express anger and resolve conflict in intimate settings. - Saturn alignment: Long-term commitment potential, whether you share similar views on responsibility, family, and long-term goals. - 4th/7th/8th house overlaps: Alignment on home life, marriage, and deep emotional intimacy needs. - Placeholder: [Specific recommendations for your chart: e.g., "You will thrive with a partner who has Venus in Earth signs, as they will match your need for consistent, practical displays of affection."] ### 3.3 Platonic Friend Specific Traits to Look For - 3rd/5th/11th house overlaps: Shared hobbies, social energy levels, and group activity preferences. - Jupiter alignment: Shared sense of adventure, belief systems, and willingness to try new experiences together. - Mars alignment: How you will support each other through challenges and celebrate wins together. - Placeholder: [Specific recommendations for your chart: e.g., "You will build the strongest friendships with people who have Mercury in Air signs, as you will enjoy deep, wide-ranging conversations and share a similar sense of humor."] --- ## Section 4: 12-Month Weekly Transit Predictions This section provides week-by-week personalized forecasts based on planetary movements relative to your birth chart, with actionable guidance for each period: ### Forecast Structure (Repeated for Each of 52 Weeks) **Week [X]: [Date Range]** - **Key Planetary Transits**: List major transits (e.g., Mercury enters Gemini, Saturn squares your natal Sun, New Moon in Taurus) - **Focus Area**: Which area of your life is most affected this week (career, relationships, health, personal growth, finances) - **Opportunities**: Specific positive outcomes or chances to take advantage of this week - **Challenges**: Potential obstacles or tense dynamics to be aware of - **Actionable Tip**: 1-2 specific steps you can take to maximize benefits or navigate challenges #### Sample Week Entry: > **Week 1: April 8 - April 14, 2026** > - Key Transits: Mercury enters your 2nd house of finances, New Moon in Aries in your 1st house > - Focus Area: New personal goals and financial planning > - Opportunities: Perfect week to set new career goals, ask for a raise, or start a side hustle > - Challenges: Avoid impulsive purchases with the Aries New Moon energy; wait 48 hours before making any large buys > - Actionable Tip: Schedule a 30-minute budget review on Wednesday to align your spending with your 2026 financial goals. ### Annual Overview Note (At end of transit section): All forecasts are guidance, not fixed outcomes. Your choices and reactions to transiting energy will shape the results you experience. Use these weekly notes as a roadmap to align your actions with the energy available to you each week. --- ## Final Notes This report is a tool for self-reflection and growth. No placement is inherently "good" or "bad"—every trait has both a light and shadow expression, and you have full agency to choose how you show up in the world.
